text:
Bitcoin enters a tight consolidation phase near $62,500, shedding 2% amidst shifting macro drivers. Market sensitivity has abruptly pivoted from geopolitical headlines to dollar liquidity, particularly as hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials cap upside momentum despite fresh June CPI data.

The latest U.S. Consumer Price Index report revealed a 0.4% monthly contraction and an annualized headline inflation drop to 3.5%, largely driven by softening energy prices. However, money markets are heavily pricing in persistent core services inflation, keeping July rate hike probabilities elevated near 50%.

Digital assets are increasingly trading as high-beta liquidity proxies. With WTI crude oil rebounding near $80 per barrel and traditional equities bracing for sustained restrictive monetary policy, institutional capital flows remain defensively positioned across risk assets, directly constraining crypto market depth and spot volumes.
